topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The sun slanted through the window, a warm stroke on my arm as I turned a page. Suddenly, a knock—a gentle rap, like a soft breeze speaking. There, on the doorstep, a small package. The wrapping was simple, but the care was evident in each fold. Inside, a book, the cover worn, pages yellowed, a note tucked inside. "For the spark you lit," it read. My hands traced the words, memories flooding back—laughing over puzzles, the scent of chalk, the quiet moments of discovery. Each line, each memory, wove a tapestry of moments shared. The day stretched long and full, a fine tapestry of time.
